prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `shortest(nodes, edges, source)` in src/lib.rs for a directed weighted graph. Edges are `(from, to, weight)`. Return a vector of `Option<u64>` distances, using `None` for unreachable nodes. Return `None` for an out-of-range source or edge endpoint. Duplicate edges are allowed; keep the cheapest. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
